construct: RULED, THE K2 CELL (refreshed 2026-09-21): k2_overview 40–70w (the persona's current in the element's arena) + k2_functional ≤22w (the god's own family function, re-ruled 2026-09-01) + k2_domain_readings 18–55w per ruled domain (owner construct 2026-08-19, corpus ×50 LOCKED) · adj_chips {catalyst ×3, friction ×3} 1–3w under THE KEYWORD DERIVATION CHAIN (2026-09-03) and THE VOCABULARY ZONE B1–B2 (2026-09-04) · fn_reading = the weighted three-door ledger {word, doors:{trait, scene, outside}} ×3 per pole, 35–55w per door (THE THREE DOORS 2026-09-03; corpus ×50 complete 2026-09-04) · structural_interaction = the REA_03 §4b authoring seed · k2_card = the unauthored register stub (REA_03 §4, superseded by the cell above). Prompts: REA_17 §3.4. · edge (catalyst pole only; owner 2026-10-16, THE EDGE v9: two sentences, the energy and its three ruling domains from the GOD table, then a clause per domain in The Pattern's voice; the metric; the head derived in the app)
candidate_note: LOCKED corpus ×50 (k2 cell 2026-08-19; chips and ledger 2026-09-04); k2_card registers remain an unauthored stub.

candidates.structural_interaction: Metal directing Wood cross-polarity — precision shaping reach toward structured outcomes
candidates.k2_overview: Your Wood moves as the Steward: growth banked in rings. You build worth the way orchards do, planted early, tended patiently, harvested honestly, replanted always. Assets in your care grow. So do people. Your fortune is cumulative and alive, and it rewards the seasons you refuse to rush.
candidates.k2_functional: You build annually: steady deposits of effort that quietly become an estate.

k2_domain_readings.Wealth: Your wealth is orchard-shaped: productive assets, patient growth, income in seasons. You like what grows on its own, a skill, a plot, a stake left alone, and you let time do the heaviest lifting. It intends to.
k2_domain_readings.Savings: You save like a granary: harvests stored against winters. Rotate the stock, reinvest the surplus, and remember granaries exist so that planting can be brave.
k2_domain_readings.Steady love: You love agriculturally: devotion planted deep, tended daily, expected to fruit for decades. Choose a fellow gardener. Then keep courting through every season, even the mud ones.

catalyst.define: As a catalyst, little takes root at first. What does take hold grows slowly under your care and lasts.

angles.drive: Building slowly is where you feel most sure of yourself. You have more push than Wood to put it into, so you build one thing for years rather than chase several. Your work is still standing when quicker efforts have fallen.
angles.cost_self: Whatever matters to you, you build for years. You put the thing in hand ahead of the wanted one and keep at it while your wish waits. A part of you still aches for the dream you set aside.
angles.cost_others: You provide by building what lasts. Since you put finished ahead of shared, you build in private and keep the people near you waiting. Your family sees the result and very little of the making.

angles.drive: Saving comes before spending for you, without your ever deciding it. Being covered means more than anything you would buy, so you save instead of wanting. Your household weathers bad years that sink other families.
angles.cost_self: Your safety lives in what you have saved. Since you put feeling covered ahead of feeling alive, you save by postponing the small pleasures. Whole seasons of your life pass without a single treat.
angles.cost_others: Whenever the people at home want something, you are already saving. Because safety together matters more than happiness today, you set saving above the wish. Your family never wonders where the next month's money comes from.

angles.drive: Being loyal comes before being exciting for you. Being known feels safer than being wanted, so you stay loyal on dull days as much as good ones. The person beside you has never once doubted you.
angles.cost_self: Where you gave your word, you stay loyal after the reasons change. Since loyalty feels more like love than choosing, you stop asking whether this is what you want or promised. Some of your choices were made once and never made again.
angles.cost_others: Loyalty is how you love, given rather than said. You rate being loyal above speaking up, and you give the person you are with your presence more than your feelings. Your partner gets all of your time and few of your words.

friction.define: As a friction, the work takes more out of you than it gives back. Needing to feel covered, you guard each gain and take little joy in it.

angles.drive: Leaving comes hard to you, and you stay where the giving back stopped. You have more Wood than strength for it, so you stay rather than face what leaving costs. You keep paying in effort every month to a place that returns none of it.
angles.cost_self: Where you settle, you stay, and settled is your word for stuck. Because the unknown worries you more than the known bores you, you stay instead of trying the new. By staying, you miss the better love or pay you never looked for.
angles.cost_others: You stay in a love the way you stay anywhere. Since ending feels more like failing than choosing, you keep a love going after it has stopped growing. You spend your partner's years along with your own.

angles.drive: Counting what something cost matters to you more than enjoying it. Wood takes more from you than it gives, so you count what you have rather than use it. You are allowed to enjoy a thing without pricing it first.
angles.cost_self: With money, you count before you feel. Because being caught short frightens you more than being bored, you count the cost instead of living the day. You give up the easy days that all your counting was meant to buy.
angles.cost_others: For the people you love, you count as closely as yourself. Since a cost stays with you longer than a pleasure, you count shared things aloud rather than let them pass. You take the small treats out of their days, one price at a time.

angles.drive: Trusting takes you years, losing it an afternoon. You carry more Wood than stamina to match, so you trust proof over feeling. You only want to be safe from hurt, and the long wait for proof hurts too.
angles.cost_self: Whenever you let someone new near, you take years to trust. Since a wrong guess feels worse than loneliness, you hold out for proof before trusting. Holding out, you lose the closeness and the years that waiting for proof uses up.
angles.cost_others: You make the people who love you prove it first. Trusting first feels like handing over the means to hurt you, so you ask for proof. You hand all the proving to the one you love while you wait to trust.

edge.lead: Wood runs through your wealth, your family and your career. It is the savings that carry you past a slow month, the people you show up for on ordinary days, and the long job you keep after the quick starters quit.
